context: Revalidate the drift still exists, confirm/rebuild darwin-x86_64 dbgen+qgen from current EOL_HANDLING source, unify root and packaged trees to byte-identical, regenerate checksums.md5 in GNU format (matching darwin-arm64) so the runtime verifier actually checks it. Separate PR from #1256.
description: PR #1256 fixed the darwin-arm64 packaged/source binary mismatch; darwin-x86_64 is the last TPC-H platform still drifted. Verified 2026-07-21 on origin/develop 593a150b7: root (_binaries) vs packaged (benchbox/_binaries) dbgen AND qgen differ, and the shipped benchbox/_binaries/tpc-h/darwin-x86_64/checksums.md5 lists dbgen=34c12bb13e2eb6e5562ab81e1fb56386 which matches NEITHER on-disk dbgen (root 88c14d33, packaged 358243bc) -- a stale/incorrect manifest. qgen entry matches. Manifests are BSD format so tpc_compilation._verify_checksum silently skips verification (its parser only matches GNU 'hash filename' lines), so the shipped darwin-x86_64 dbgen is unverified and may predate the EOL_HANDLING rebuild -- a latent framing/reproducibility risk on that platform. dists.dss is consistent.
